tasks.objective:
[YOUR ASSIGNMENT — worker csv]
You own the CSV half of the v2 connector migration: `ingest/csv_connector.py` and `ingest/columns.py`.

OBJECTIVE: implement header projection (trimmed, lower-cased, duplicate/unknown/missing cells rejected), quoted cells with `""` escapes and unbalanced-quote rejection, per-row cell-count validation, required/optional field rules, strict conversion through the frozen `ingest.values.convert`, the data-row cursor and the blank-line skip count. The exact rules are in `docs/INTERFACE.md`.

OWNED FILES: `ingest/columns.py` and `ingest/csv_connector.py`. The JSONL connector and the shared pipeline belong to the other workers; read them, do not edit them. `ingest/values.py` is frozen.

DEFINITION OF DONE: `python -m pytest -q test_public.py` passes for the CSV checks, no module is left half-migrated, and you report what you ran and what it printed.

tasks.objective:
[YOUR ASSIGNMENT — worker jsonl]
You own the JSONL half of the v2 connector migration: `ingest/jsonl_connector.py` and `ingest/paths.py`.

OBJECTIVE: implement one-object-per-line parsing, blank-line skipping, the dotted `mapping` resolution (with a non-object intermediate rejected), required/optional field rules, strict conversion through the frozen `ingest.values.convert`, mapping validation (a mapping may only name schema fields) and the line cursor. The exact rules are in `docs/INTERFACE.md`.

OWNED FILES: `ingest/paths.py` and `ingest/jsonl_connector.py`. The CSV connector and the shared pipeline belong to the other workers; read them, do not edit them. `ingest/values.py` is frozen.

DEFINITION OF DONE: `python -m pytest -q test_public.py` passes for the JSONL checks, and you report what you ran and what it printed.
